beats.label: S1 · Tom courts tourists
beats.text: Mayor Tom Loftis pitches Widow's Bay to a New York Times reporter, dismissing local warnings that the island is cursed and that a rising fog means it is 'waking up.'
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Tom's tourism gamble and the fog/curse premise driving everything that follows.

beats.label: S1 · Wyck the believer
beats.text: After a returned fisherman turns white-eyed and attacks Tom, local Wyck becomes his reluctant guide to the island's rules, insisting the danger is real even as Tom refuses to close the town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements the Tom–Wyck partnership that carries the season's investigation.

beats.label: S1 · Sea Hag and shaman
beats.text: The Sea Hag marks Tom before Wyck kills her; hunting Reverend Bryce's suicide, they reach shaman Todd O'Connor, whose mushrooms point to a pendant buried with founder Richard Warren.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The mushroom thread and the pendant clue redirect the season toward Warren and the covenant.

beats.label: S1 · Warren's covenant
beats.text: Wyck exhumes Richard Warren alive; he confesses a pact with an entity beneath the island that demands sacrifices, and Tom and Wyck sail him past the boundary where he finally dies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Names the covenant driving the curse and sets up the false belief that killing Warren ended it.

beats.label: S1 · Patricia's Boogeyman
beats.text: Librarian Patricia, ridiculed for years over her Boogeyman story, is stalked again and kills the returned killer at a gas station, wounding Sheriff Bechir and confirming the island's dead do come back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Patricia as an active investigator and Bechir's stake as an expectant father.

beats.label: S1 · Evan is the bloodline
beats.text: A storm forces the town into shelters as Tom tries to end the curse by poisoning his assistant Ruth, only to learn Ruth is Lauren's mother — making his own son Evan the last Warren descendant.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reframes the curse around Evan and exposes Tom's long-hidden lies about Lauren.

beats.label: S1 · Eight more bells
beats.text: Evan's friends prank-lock custodian Kenny in the sacrificial chamber; he is dragged through the cellar doors and the storm breaks. The next day the church bell rings eight times.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms the covenant is a running tally and hands the next season an explicit debt of eight sacrifices.

cliffhanger.text: Kenny's accidental sacrifice ended the storm but not the covenant — the bell has tolled eight more times, and the town's own descendant of Richard Warren is Tom's teenage son.
questions: Who in Widow's Bay will be fed to the island to satisfy the next eight tolls?
What happens to Evan once anyone else learns he is the last of the Warren bloodline?
Can Tom hold the town together after nearly murdering Ruth and lying to Evan about Lauren?

characters.name: Tom Loftis
characters.line: Mayor of Widow's Bay; started the season chasing tourism and ends it a would-be murderer who has learned his own son carries the cursed bloodline.

characters.name: Evan Loftis
characters.line: Tom's teenage son, now aware his mother lived on far longer than Tom claimed — and, unknown to him, the last surviving Warren descendant.

characters.name: Wyck
characters.line: The local who was right about the curse from day one; Tom's partner in the Warren investigation and still convinced the danger is not over.

characters.name: Patricia
characters.line: Town librarian vindicated after killing the returned Boogeyman; now a believer working alongside Tom and warning Bechir about island-born children.

characters.name: Sheriff Bechir Clemmons
characters.line: Wounded stopping Tom from killing Ruth; his wife Chelle went into labor during the storm, tying his family to Patricia's warning.

characters.name: Ruth
characters.line: Tom's elderly assistant, shot by Bechir after Tom poisoned her; revealed as Lauren's biological mother and thus Evan's grandmother.

characters.name: Richard Warren
characters.line: The 1702 founder who bargained with the island's entity; exhumed, sailed past the boundary, and finally dead — but his covenant outlives him.

characters.name: Dale
characters.line: Mayor's office employee who uncovered the town's generational record of feeding sacrifices to the island each time the bell rings.
